# dbterm

> Keyboard-first terminal database workbench and native backup agent for PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Turso and Cloudflare D1.

dbterm is created and maintained by Shreyam Adhikari (`shreyam1008`). It is an MIT-licensed Go project distributed as one cross-platform binary. The canonical product origin is `https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/` and the source of truth is `https://github.com/shreyam1008/dbterm`.

Important scope: backup supports all five database targets; restore currently supports PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, and local SQLite. The MCP server is local STDIO with read-only database execution. dbterm does not expose a hosted API, OAuth service, remote MCP endpoint, or autonomous agent endpoint.

## Documentation

- [Complete user guide](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/guide.md): Installation, connections, dashboard, workspace, SQL, results, relationships, Change Profiler, services, backup, settings, CLI, paths, security, and troubleshooting.
- [Backup Center handbook](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/backup.md): Full backup job, agent, storage, retention, encryption, notification, inspection, and restore reference.
- [Local MCP server guide](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/agents.md): Agent setup, tools, scope controls, runtime flags, and read-only safety model.
- [Change Profiler architecture](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/change-profiler.md): Portable before/after capture model and its attribution boundary.
- [Complete combined context](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/llms-full.txt): Repository overview plus every primary operating manual in one document.

## Agent integration

- [Agent Skill discovery index](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Machine-readable index and digest for the public dbterm skill.
- [Use dbterm Agent Skill](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/.well-known/agent-skills/use-dbterm/SKILL.md): Installable operating and safety instructions for agents using dbterm MCP.
- [API catalog](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset for the public documentation API.
- [OpenAPI document](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/openapi.json): Read-only catalog of public documentation resources.
- [ARD capability manifest](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Agentic Resource Discovery entries for the skill, API catalog, and local STDIO MCP server.
- [MCP Server Card](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Local `dbterm mcp serve` transport and read-only capabilities.
- [Auth metadata](https://dbterm.shreyam1008.com.np/auth.md): Anonymous documentation-site boundary; dbterm has no hosted OAuth service.
